items.title: Arturo Sandoval interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2023
items.q: Arturo was interviewed via Zoom on June 12, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Arturo was interviewed via Zoom on June 12, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and it’s a real privilege to have Arturo Sandoval with me this morning. Thank you very much for joining me.
